title: EzRestero — Scan. Order. Enjoy. AI-Powered Restaurant Platform
summary: The complete QR-based restaurant ordering platform. Customers scan, browse, order, and track — all without downloading an app. You get real-time orders, AI insights, and powerful analytics.
challenge: Traditional POS systems suffered from slow order routing, kitchen delays, high app download barriers for customers, and poor table QR ordering experiences.
solution: AiKodX engineered a zero-app web platform with sub-50ms table checkout, AI-powered menu insights, live KDS kitchen routing, and an instant Admin Dashboard.

title: MSG — Premium Ladies Suits, Sarees & Ethnic Wear Store
summary: High-converting D2C e-commerce platform for premium ladies suits, designer silk sarees, dupattas, and custom tailored ethnic wear.
challenge: MSG required an ultra-fast, mobile-first e-commerce store with high-res saree zoom viewports, custom stitching option selectors, and 1-click WhatsApp checkout.
solution: AiKodX engineered a Next.js headless storefront with sub-50ms page transitions, custom fabric filters, interactive size guides, and integrated WhatsApp order routing.

title: Dropizi Courier — Dynamic Logistics & Parcel Delivery Engine
summary: Upcoming end-to-end courier dispatching platform, dynamic parcel route optimization, and live GPS delivery tracking.
challenge: Manual courier assignment and legacy tracking systems caused delay bottlenecks across last-mile delivery.
solution: Developing autonomous parcel assignment algorithms, driver mobile dispatch portals, and live SMS/WhatsApp delivery alerts.
